title: Changing a theme revalidates that one Space and nothing else

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Confirmed no rebuild is involved: site renders are anonymous ISR under the cross-request tag site:<slug>; saveWebsiteStyle already called refreshSite(slug) when the look or theme changes, which expires that one Space's tag and /sites tree. Shipped: lib/sites/site-cache-theme.test.ts pins that, and the probe pins the call. Publish already refreshes through the same seam.

verify.note: Reads the saveWebsiteStyle call and its pinning test. Premise re-tested: the behaviour already existed on main, so this row only pins it.
